details:
Q1. Which exact area of this repository should this issue target?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflows or supporting scripts
B. Review-autofix / orchestrate / judge / conflict-resolution behavior
C. Validate / memory / update-workflows / other automation
D. Docs / README / operator guidance
E. Another specific workflow, script, or file path - please name it (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What is the main problem with that area today?
Choices:
A. Something is incorrect, failing, or flaky (RECOMMENDED)
B. It works, but it is too noisy, slow, or hard to use
C. The docs, prompts, or messages are unclear or incomplete
D. The implementation is too brittle or hard to maintain
Q3. What concrete reference should planning use as the source of truth for "better"?
Choices:
A. A failing workflow/job/run or log symptom - please identify it (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific issue, PR, or comment thread - please point to it
C. A specific file/path plus a short before/after expectation (RECOMMENDED)
D. A plain-language acceptance criterion describing what should be better
